about.en: Securitize bStock (SECZB) is a tokenized share of Securitize Corp. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0x32c980f38907ace4fac643c3765d9b32842af60f, backed 1:1 by SECZ shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
